    AI Overview
    Vanderbilt men’s basketball coach Mark Byington came to Vanderbilt from James Madison University, where he served as head coach for four seasons (2020–2024), culminating in a 32-4 record and an NCAA Tournament win in 2024. He was hired by Vanderbilt in March 2024 following successful coaching stints at James Madison and Georgia Southern. 
    Key Background Details: 
    • Previous Role: Head Coach at James Madison (82–36 record).
    • Prior Experience: Head Coach at Georgia Southern (2013–2020), assistant coaching roles at Virginia Tech, College of Charleston, anddirector of operations at Virginia.
    • Playing Career:
      Played at UNC Wilmington.
    • Style: Known for high-paced offense and rebuilding programs. 
    Byington replaced former coach Jerry Stackhouse.
